mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (order_info_id, payment_number, amount, payment_method, imp_uid, created_at) VALUES (#{orderInfoId}, #{paymentNumber}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{impUid}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT
-- 주문 항목 oi.product_name, oi.price_per_unit, oi.quantity, oi.order_item_id, oi.order_info_id, -- 상품 정보 p.product_id, p.product_info, p.file_category, p.file_name,
-- 결제 정보 pay.payment_id, pay.payment_method, pay.created_at AS paycreated_at, pay.amount AS payamount, pay.payment_number, pay.imp_uid
FROM order_item AS oi INNER JOIN product AS p on oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN payment AS pay on oi.order_info_id = pay.order_info_id
where oi.order_info_id =#{orderInfoId}
